# hpe_morpheus_virtual_switch (Data Source)



Look a virtual switch up either by its `id`, or by `cluster_id` together with `name`
(the switch name is unique within a cluster). Requires Morpheus 9.1.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_virtual_switch" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_virtual_switch" "example" {
  cluster_id = 1
  name       = "vswitch01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster (server group) that owns this virtual switch.
- `id` (Number) The Morpheus ID of the virtual switch. Look up by id, or by cluster_id and name.
- `name` (String) Switch name. Used with cluster_id to look the switch up.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the switch is active.
- `base_type` (String) The switch base type.
- `bond_mode` (String) NIC bonding mode. Null indicates single-NIC (no bond) mode.
- `code` (String) The code identifier for the switch.
- `description` (String) The description of the switch.
- `mtu` (Number) Switch MTU.
- `network_count` (Number) Number of traffic segments defined on the switch.
- `nic_count` (Number) Number of distinct physical NICs consumed across all host uplinks.
- `segments` (Attributes List) Traffic segments defined on the switch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segments))
- `status` (String) Sync status of the switch.
- `status_message` (String) Additional detail about the current status, when present.
- `uplinks` (Attributes List) Host uplink NIC assignments for the switch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uplinks))

<a id="nestedatt--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `segments`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) The gateway for the segment.
- `host_ips` (Attributes List) Per-host IP address assignments for this segment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segments--host_ips))
- `id` (Number) The Morpheus ID of the segment.
- `interface_name` (String) OS interface carrying this traffic (e.g. bond0, bond0.220).
- `ip_address` (String) The IP address assigned to the segment.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU for the segment.
- `netmask` (String) The netmask for the segment.
- `ovs_bridge` (String) OVS bridge name reported by hvmcli (VM traffic only).
- `ovs_libvirt_network` (String) OVS libvirt network name reported by hvmcli.
- `ovs_uuid` (String) OVS bridge UUID reported by hvmcli.
- `status` (String) Sync status of the segment.
- `status_message` (String) Additional detail about the segment status, when present.
- `traffic_type` (String) The traffic type carried by this segment.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN tag. Null means untagged.

<a id="nestedatt--segments--host_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `segments.host_ips`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) The IP address assigned to the segment on this host.
- `server_id` (Number) The ID of the host (compute server) this IP is assigned to.



<a id="nestedatt--uplinks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uplinks`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The Morpheus ID of the uplink.
- `last_sync_date` (String) When the uplink was last synced from the host, as an RFC 3339 timestamp; null until the first sync.
- `nic1` (String) Primary physical NIC name.
- `nic2` (String) Secondary NIC name. Null in single-NIC mode.
- `server_id` (Number) The ID of the host (compute server) this uplink applies to.
- `server_name` (String) The name of the host this uplink applies to.
- `sync_message` (String) Additional detail about the uplink sync status, when present.
- `sync_status` (String) Sync status of the uplink.
